title: POST /v1/config request
description: Which build is asking, and which config schema versions it can execute. The version list is not a minimum-version pin: a version floor can brick a fleet that cannot move, and an explicit 409 on an unsupported config_version refuses cleanly instead of applying a document partially. The server decodes this request tolerantly, so new fields ship client-first.

agent_version.description: The shipper build's canonical version string. The same value travels in the X-Shipper-Version header on every request.

config_versions.description: Config schema versions this build can execute. The server answers 409 when the intersection with what it serves is empty.
